timeline.description: Completed SSC (10th Grade) with 90.40% from Vidya Pratishthan's New English Medium School, Baramati.
Completed HSC (12th Grade) with 82.17% from Ajit Dada English Medium & Junior College, Kathphal, Baramati.
Began pursuing a B.Tech in Information Technology at Marathwada Mitra Mandal's College of Engineering (MMCOE), Pune.
Developed Eventra, an event management platform, as part of a hackathon.
Completed Semester 2 with an SGPA of 8.27, resulting in a First Year CGPA of 8.61.
Designed the user interface for FinPilot using Figma, focusing on intuitive and modern user experience.
Built HydroStat, a research-driven platform focused on hydrogen technologies, integrating research, interactive learning, and modern web development.
Registered for an ORCID iD to support and establish my academic and research contributions.
Joined Elite Coders Summer of Code (ECSoC) 2026 as a Contributor, collaborating on open-source projects and enhancing my development skills.
Designed and developed my personal portfolio website to showcase my projects, achievements, and continuous learning journey.
Developed Mauli, a modern web platform transforming the ancient pilgrimage experience with advance darshan booking and live queue tracking.

Continuing to learn, build, and contribute to meaningful software projects while exploring Artificial Intelligence, Web Development, and Open Source. Every project is an opportunity to improve, solve real-world problems, and grow as a developer.
